quarryHelp: An occupied quarry reduces building costs by 1 coin, within the building’s quarry limit. Choose it with the Planter privilege or an occupied Builder’s Yard.
forestHelp: Created with an occupied Lumberyard. Takes no worker and produces no goods. Every two forests give a 1-coin building discount through the Lumberyard.
cornHelp: With a worker or citizen, produces 1 corn during Craftsman, if available in the supply. No production building needed.
plantationHelp: Produces its good during Craftsman: one worker or citizen here and one in the matching production building per crate, subject to supply.
productionTiming: At Craftsman · before the role bonus
staffPlantation: Place a worker on a plantation
staffWorkshop: Place a worker in the production building
noProductionYet: Choose a plantation, then place a worker on it.
matchingWorkers: Producing one good requires two workers: one on a matching plantation and one in this building.
productionIntro: Plantations and production buildings stay on your board. The Craftsman phase adds the goods produced to your stock.
productionPair: 1 occupied plantation + 1 occupied production slot → 1 good. Corn needs only an occupied plantation.
goodsMeaning: A good is one unit of corn, fruit, sugar, tobacco or coffee. The rulebook calls these units crates; there is no separate crate resource.
useStock: Sell your stock with Trader for coins, or load ships with Captain for victory points.
storageMeaning: Storage buildings help keep unsent goods after Captain. They do not produce goods.
festivalReservedHelp: These crates mark the objective and cannot be produced until it is completed. They then return to the common supply, separately from the winner’s reward.
baseSalePrices: Base price per crate · before bonuses
productionComparisonHelp: Production capacity before the role bonus; shared supply may limit actual production.
rolesHelpIntro: For shared roles, everyone acts, starting with the chooser. Only the chooser gets the privilege and the coins on the role.
roleWarningOthers: Other players can still use this role if able.
warnProductionSetup: You cannot produce any {crates} yet. Your estate and its matching production building must be occupied. {corn} only needs an occupied estate.
warnProductionSupply: The supply has no {crates} of the types you can produce.
warnBuildMoney: You cannot afford a building, even with the role’s {coins}, your discounts and payment bonuses.
warnBuildSpace: No available building can be added to your city: check free spaces and buildings you already own.
warnTradeFull: The trading house is full. You cannot sell any goods.
warnTradeTypes: The trading house already contains every type you could sell.
warnShipSpace: No ship can accept your {crates} right now.
warnPlantSpace: Your plantations already fill all 12 spaces. You cannot take another plantation.
warnPlantSupply: No estate or {quarry} is available for you to take.
warnRecruitSupply: Neither recruitment nor worker reassignment is possible for you.
warnSmugglerTargets: There is nothing to raid, plunder or poach, and no role left to capture.
chooseDraft: Choose a building for the shared market
haciendaHint: Draw an extra estate before choosing.
forestHint: Keep this estate or make it a forest.
villaHint: Receive a citizen, or a worker if none remain.
scoreHidden: This player's VP tokens stay hidden until game end.
scoreCounterHint: These are the points shown on the player card.
scoreUnrecorded: Points not detailed in the saved history
scoreEstimateHint: Based on the current board; separate from the VP token counter. Building bonuses require an occupied building.
scoreFinalHint: These points are added to the VP tokens earned.
scoreCitizensHint: 1 VP per citizen, including those in reserve.
scoreSoloAchievements: In solo play, incomplete human Achievements score for Puertomas only.
scoreEstimateTotal: Total if the game ended now
workerTool: Tap a slot to assign the selected worker. Tap an occupied slot to remove it.
storageHint: Keep one good, plus the storage provided by occupied buildings.
festivalTrade: Sell the fourth good to fill the trading house:
festivalBigShip: Complete the largest cargo ship’s load with:
festivalSmallShip: Complete the smallest cargo ship’s load with:
ruleGoal: Win with the most VP: ship goods and develop your city. Coins pay for buildings; goods can be sold for {coins} or shipped for points.
ruleChoose: The Governor chooses an available role and takes its coins. That role becomes the next phase; there is no fixed role order.
ruleFollow: The chooser acts first and gets the privilege (for example, Builder: {coin:−1}), then everyone follows clockwise with the same action.
ruleNext: After the phase, the next player chooses a different role. Repeat until everyone has chosen once. Used roles stay unavailable this round.
ruleNextTwo: After each phase, alternate choosing different roles until you have each chosen three. Used roles stay unavailable this round.
ruleReset: Add {coin:1} to each unchosen role, return the chosen roles, and pass the Governor to the next player.
ruleOptional: Actions and privileges are optional, except mandatory shipping. Smuggler and Adventurer, when present, only let their chooser act.
ruleOptionalBase: You can decline an action or privilege, except mandatory shipping.
ruleProductionTitle: From an estate to a good
ruleProductionIntro: Build this chain through the roles chosen by you or your opponents:
ruleProduction: Example: an occupied {sugar} estate + an occupied sugar-mill slot produce {sugar:1} during Craftsman. Corn needs no building. Empty tiles neither produce nor activate effects.
ruleActivation: Rearrange all your {workers} during Recruiter. Occupied {quarries} discount construction, within the building’s limit.
ruleGoodsTitle: Sell for coins, ship for points
ruleSell: Sell {crate:1} per player. The market has 4 spaces, normally {crate:1} per type. It empties at phase end only if full.
ruleShip: Take turns loading one type for {vp:1} per good. Loading is mandatory when possible: use the ship accepting the most of your chosen type. Repeat until nobody can load.
ruleShipLimits: One type per ship; no type on two public ships. After loading, keep {crate:1} in total (more with storage buildings) and discard the rest. Full ships then empty; the others keep their cargo.
ruleTiming: Choosing a role helps your opponents too. Check who can produce, sell or fill a ship before you.
ruleDraft: Initial building selection creates a shared market, not personal purchases. Tap a building for its price and effect.
ruleDetails: Tap a building to read its effect and price.
ruleCitizens: Citizens fill {worker} slots and score {vp:1} each. Some building effects depend on whether a {worker} or {citizen} occupies them.
ruleSmuggler: Raid a ship, plunder the market, poach {workers} or capture a role. A captured role gives {coin:3} if chosen by someone else; otherwise you play it at round end. Another player must choose Smuggler before you can choose it again.
ruleAdventurer: Only the chooser gains {coin:1}, plus the {coins} already on this role.
ruleFestival: The first player to fulfill each shared objective earns its reward automatically.
ruleEnd: A full city (12 spaces) or an empty VP token supply triggers the end of the game. Finish the current round’s remaining role phases, then count points.
ruleEndWorkers: Being unable to refill the work register after Recruiter also triggers the end of the game, at the end of that round.
ruleEndCitizens: With Citizens, {worker} shortage does not end the game.
ruleScore: Score your VP tokens, printed building points (even if empty), and occupied buildings’ endgame bonuses. Ties: most {coins} + remaining {crates}.
totalStorage: Store all goods of this type
journalPreviewSetup: The building market was prepared automatically for this preview.
journalEndWorkers: The work register could not be refilled.
achievementHelp: Complete your four secret objectives at any point. Completed cards are revealed and score at game end without taking VP tokens.
puertomaHelp: Puertoma uses its own estate slots, permanent workers, building levels and unlocked abilities. Uncompleted human Achievements score for every Puertoma; completed ones score no points for humans.
effect.hacienda: Optional extra estate from the bag before choosing.
effect.smallWarehouse: Store every {crate} of one type, plus the usual {crate}.
effect.hospital: {worker:1} on an estate or {quarry} gained this phase.
effect.office: May sell a type already in the trading house.
effect.largeWarehouse: Store every {crate} of two types, plus the usual {crate}.
effect.wharf: Once per {captain}: ship all {crates} of one type privately.
effect.fireStation: Score {vp:1} per small production building, {vp:2} per large.
effect.cityHall: Score {vp:1} per commercial building, including this one.
effect.canal: Large {fruit} and {sugar} buildings can produce {crate:1} extra each.
effect.lumberyard: May turn newly gained estates into {forests}. {forest:2} reduce building costs by {coin:1}.
effect.hiddenMarket: If short of cash, return at most {worker:1}, {crate:1} and {vp:1}; each pays {coin:1}.
effect.bohio: At any time, move a {worker} from Bohío to an empty plantation or building slot. It stays there until the next Recruiter.
effect.merchantOutpost: {trader}: sell up to {crate:1} to the supply instead of the Trading House, at its normal {coin} price. Trader privilege applies; no Small market or Large market bonuses.
effect.smallWharf: Once per {captain}: ship any mixed cargo, for {vp:1} per {crate:2}.
effect.distillery: Earn {coins} equal to your largest non-{corn} production, minus one.
effect.publishingHouse: Double the chosen role’s privilege. {planter} gets a second pick after everyone.
effect.assemblyHall: At {captain} start: {vp:+1} per pair of {crates} of the same type.
effect.cathedral: Sets of three matching plantations score {vp:1/3/6/10} for 1/2/3/4 sets.
effect.zoningOffice: {trader}: {worker} buys a random estate for {coin:1}; {citizen} discards an estate for {coin:1}.
effect.parkAuthority: {planter}: {worker} may discard an estate/{forest}; {citizen} earns {vp:2} with strictly fewest plantations.
effect.notary: {worker}: regular buildings cost {coin:1} less. {citizen}: {expandedbuildings} cost {coin:2} less.
effect.pensionOffice: Before shipping, exchange distinct goods for {vp:1} each, up to your {citizen} count.
effect.villa: {recruiter}: receive {citizen:1}, or {worker:1} if {citizens} have run out.
effect.tailorShop: {craftsman}: gain {coin:1} per {citizen}. Counts as a large production building.
roleAction.recruiter: Take the register’s {workers} one at a time in turn order. Then reassign all your {workers} / {citizens}.
roleAction.builder: Buy up to 1 building. Occupied {quarries} give a discount, up to the building’s limit.
roleAction.craftsman: Produce with occupied estates and matching production buildings. {corn} needs only an occupied estate.
roleAction.trader: Sell up to {crate:1} for {coins}. The trading house holds 4 goods, all different.
roleAction.captain: Take turns loading one type of good for {vp:1} per {crate}. Shipping is mandatory when possible. Keep your allowed storage ({crate:1} by default), then discard the rest.
roleAction.adventurer: Gain {coin:1}, plus the {coins} on this role.
roleAction.smuggler: Choose one: raid a ship, plunder the trading house, poach surplus {workers}, or capture a role.
rolePrivilege.recruiter: Before sharing, take up to {worker:1} extra from the supply.
rolePrivilege.craftsman: After everyone produces, take {crate:1} extra of a type you produced, if available.
rolePrivilege.smuggler: A captured role pays {coin:3} if another player chooses it; otherwise you play it at round end. Someone else must choose Smuggler before you can choose it again.
ability.storage: Store all goods of the best type and one other good.
ability.produceCrate: +1 good of the best type produced after production.
ability.goodsPoints: +1 VP per Goods type before storage.
ability.discardPoints: Discard up to 2 of the worst Good for 1 VP each before storage.
ability.recruitCoins: +1 Coin per Worker gained during recruitment.
achievementGoal.spendAll: Build an {expanded} by paying all your {coins}.
achievementGoal.goodsPair: Have at least %amount% {%goods%} combined, including at least one of each.
achievementGoal.dispatch: Place the last {crate} of {%good%} on a cargo ship to fill it.
achievementGoal.closeTrade: Sell the fourth Good to the Trading House as the {trader}.
achievementGoal.shipTypes: Load at least 3 different Goods during one {captain} phase.
achievementGoal.buildingWorkers: Have at least 12 {workers} or {citizens} placed on Buildings.
achievementGoal.fillShip: Fully load a cargo ship in one action, from empty to full.
achievementGoal.estateWorkers: Have at least 9 {workers} or {citizens} on plantations.
achievementGoal.produce: Produce at least {crate:7} during one {craftsman} phase.
achievementGoal.productionSet: Have at least 1 {sugar}, 1 {tobacco}, and 1 {coffee} Production Building.
achievementGoal.developed: Have a maximum of 2 empty plantation spaces and 2 empty city spaces.
achievementGoal.cheapExpanded: Build an {expanded} paying a maximum of {coin:6}.
achievementGoal.goods: Have at least {crate:7} of one type.
achievementGoal.store: Store at least 2 different Goods at the end of a {captain} phase.
achievementGoal.commercial: Have at least 7 regular Commercial Buildings.
achievementGoal.shipAmount: Load at least {crate:5} of the same type at once.
achievementGoal.captainPoints: Gain at least {vp:7} during one {captain} phase.
achievementGoal.tradeCoins: Sell a Good to the Trading House for at least {coin:6}.
achievementGoal.productionCount: Have at least 3 {fruit} and/or {sugar} Production Buildings.
metadata.subtitle: 1897 Special Edition
metadata.description: Choose roles, develop your island, produce goods and ship them for points. Includes all six expansions and solo play against two Puertomas.
metadata.rules: Choose a role: all players perform its action, and you receive a privilege. Plant, recruit, build, produce, trade and ship. Most points from shipping, buildings and bonuses wins.
smugglerRaidHelp: Take up to 3 goods from one ship; return the rest to the supply.
smugglerPlunderHelp: Return all trading-house goods to the supply; gain 1 VP per good.
smugglerPoachHelp: Take up to 3 surplus workers and place them immediately.
